title.description: The title at the top of the sermons page.

description.defaultMessage: The latest messages from our Sunday worship services.
description.description: The line under the sermons page's title, saying what the page lists.

latest.description: The label over the newest sermon, which the sermons page shows larger than the rest.

play.description: The accessible name of the button that starts a sermon. `title` is the sermon's title, as it is on YouTube.

all.description: The link under the latest sermons, to the church's YouTube channel.

recent.description: The heading over the three newest sermons, at the bottom of the home page.

more.description: The link under the home page's three newest sermons, to the sermons page, which lists the rest.
